Initialize the node configuration

Usage: dolos init [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --known-network <KNOWN_NETWORK>
          Use one of the well-known networks
      --remote-peer <REMOTE_PEER>
          Remote peer to use as source
      --max-chain-history <MAX_CHAIN_HISTORY>
          How much history of the chain to keep on disk
      --serve-grpc <SERVE_GRPC>
          Serve clients via gRPC [possible values: true, false]
      --serve-minibf <SERVE_MINIBF>
          Serve clients minibf via HTTP [possible values: true, false]
      --serve-minikupo <SERVE_MINIKUPO>
          Serve clients via a MiniKupo-compatible HTTP endpoint [possible values: true, false]
      --serve-trp <SERVE_TRP>
          Serve clients TRP [possible values: true, false]
      --serve-ouroboros <SERVE_OUROBOROS>
          Serve clients via Ouroboros [possible values: true, false]
      --enable-relay <ENABLE_RELAY>
          Enable relay operations [possible values: true, false]
  -c, --config <CONFIG>
          
  -h, --help
          Print help
